Shiba, etc. Make it work!!

@qqzsss @dogecoin meme coins usually enrich early insiders, not late-arriving hopefuls.

Even Dogecoin's cult history shows how gains cluster early. Anyone buying after Elon Musk's Saturday Night Live cameo in May 2021 spent three years underwater before breaking even.
